description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter named TatweejWordsAdapter for displaying a list of TatweejWord items in an Android application. It handles item binding, visual updates for active (playing) words, click debounce, and UI animations.

classes.name: TatweejWordsAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView.Adapter subclass managing the display and interaction of TatweejWord items in a list, including UI updates based on playback state and click debouncing.

classes.name: TatweejWordsAdapter.VH
classes.description: ViewHolder inner class holding references to the views within each item layout.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Updates the list of TatweejWord items and refreshes the RecyclerView.

methods.name: setPlayingIndex
methods.description: Sets the currently playing word index and updates the affected list items with minimal UI refresh.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder by inflating the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to each ViewHolder, updates visual states based on whether the item is playing, and sets click listeners with debounce control.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items.
